convoys.title: APEX VTC | One-Way Cruise 🚛
convoys.trailer: Curtain Side 2 / Closed Box (See attached image)
convoys.notes: Relaxed APEX VTC one-way convoy. Enjoy the journey, cruise together, have fun with fellow drivers and keep a smooth convoy formation. Follow the convoy leader, maintain one-lane formation, keep a safe distance and do not overtake. No rushing, no pressure – just good vibes and great driving! 🚛🔥

convoys.title: APEX VTC | European Money & XP Convoy 🚛
convoys.notes: Official APEX VTC money and XP convoy. Depart Frankfurt and deliver to Nuremberg. Regroup in Nuremberg and select a new oversized delivery to Munich. Regroup again in Munich and select another oversized delivery to Milano. Maintain formation and follow convoy leader instructions.
